notes: Synthetic: authored by hand, 2026-10-28; ai.google.dev and cloud.google.com were blocked, so field names and enums come from the machine-readable references named per case in case.json notes. Values (ids, token counts, audio) are invented. Naming: see vertex@gemini-3.8-flash. Gemini TTS on Vertex AI through /v1/audio/speech (Provider.CreateSpeech in Vertex AI mode: generateContent on the publisher model with responseModalities [AUDIO]). The publisher model ID is the Gemini API's (gemini-3.8-flash-tts, the current TTS model per google-gemini/cookbook quickstarts/Get_started_TTS.ipynb), as for this suite's other vertex@ models; googleapis/python-genai google/genai/tests/models/test_generate_content.py (test_speech_with_config and the other prebuilt-voice cases) runs one TTS model ID against both backends. Unverified until a recording: that Vertex AI serves this ID.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: no canonical field: createTime is when Vertex AI received the request, and the speech route answers with audio alone
known gap G12: Gemini's responseId is dropped and the speech route answers with audio alone, so a TTS response cannot be traced back to Google (support cases, logs)

known gap G24: the TTS usageMetadata is decoded but thrown away (CreateSpeech returns audio only); the speech route bills input characters, while Gemini TTS is priced in tokens, audio output tokens above all
